title: Former Patriots 2024 2nd-round pick abruptly retires from NFL
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Ja'Lynn Polk, drafted by the Patriots in 2024, retires at 24 after two NFL seasons.
Polk played one full season with the Patriots, recording 12 catches for 87 yards and two touchdowns.
Traded to the Saints in 2025, Polk didn't play last season due to injury and missed recent practices.

title: Mother of trooper killed in crash sues Saugus restaurant, alleging it over-served wrong-way driver
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Trooper Kevin Trainor's mother filed a $20 million lawsuit against Tribu Mexican Kitchen & Bar for allegedly overserving alcohol to Hernan Ramon Marrero.
Barbara Trainor accuses the restaurant of serving Marrero nine drinks, ignoring intoxication signs before the fatal May 6 crash.
The lawsuit claims Tribu's managers failed to follow alcohol-service rules; a response from the restaurant is pending.

title: Red Sox trade deadline live updates: Will Craig Breslow make another big move?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox acquired Curtis Mead from Nationals for Connelly Early, but Mead is now injured with a wrist fracture.
Boston is interested in acquiring several top players, needing another bat after Mead's injury ahead of the trade deadline.
Red Sox unlikely to acquire Marlins star Otto Lopez, but may consider targeting catcher Liam Hicks before the deadline.

title: Man killed in East Boston overnight shooting
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A man was killed in a shooting near 464 Meridian St., East Boston, early Sunday morning.
Police responded shortly before 1:30 a.m.; victim died at a local hospital.
No arrests have been made; Boston Police Homicide Unit is investigating the incident.

title: 2 men injured in late-night shooting in Dorchester, police say
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Two men were injured in a shooting on Friday at 31 Hancock St., Dorchester, police reported.
Both victims sustained non-life-threatening injuries and received medical attention at local hospitals.
Boston police have not identified any suspects or filed charges, and the investigation continues.

title: Woman trapped, injured in second incident on MBTA Davis escalator this year
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: A woman was injured when her clothing got trapped in an escalator at MBTA Davis Station.
The incident is the second this year at Davis Station, following a fatal accident in February.
The MBTA urges caution around escalators and emphasizes use of safety features like emergency stop buttons.

title: 2 men arrested after allegedly stealing chain, wallet at knifepoint in Dorchester
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Deivi Yoander Sanchez Aguasvivas and Luis Miguel Ramirez-Astacio arrested for armed robbery in Dorchester on Thursday.
Police said the victim was robbed at knifepoint on Humboldt Ave. by suspects on a blue moped.
Aguasvivas arraigned and held without bail; Ramirez-Astacio found with outstanding warrants, including assault charges.

title: It’s not too late to submit your idea for $2 million in Boston spending
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston extends deadline to August 7 for residents to submit projects for $2 million participatory budgeting.
Participatory budgeting allows Boston residents to propose projects for city funding, focusing on equity and community impact.
Final proposals will be selected after community forums, with voting set from Jan. 15 to Feb. 15, 2027.

title: Watch: Ceddanne Rafaela hits home runs in back-to-back at-bats
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela hit back-to-back home runs in his first two at-bats for the Red Sox against the Dodgers.
Rafaela's homers came off Dodgers pitcher Yoshinobu Yamamoto, giving the Red Sox a lead and then tying the game.
Rafaela increased his season home run tally from 11 to 14 within two games at Dodger Stadium.

title: Red Sox reportedly attempted to acquire shortstop Elly De La Cruz, turned down by Reds
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: The Boston Red Sox attempted to acquire shortstop Elly De La Cruz from the Cincinnati Reds before the trade deadline.
The proposed trade was primarily prospect-based, but agreement on the framework was not reached between the teams.
Despite acquiring Curtis Mead for depth, Boston is actively seeking a shortstop upgrade due to injuries and pressing needs.
